_comment: Shared vectors pinning the interaction digest across its two implementations (src/replay/interaction_digest.zig and src/replay/js/interaction_digest.js). NEITHER implementation is the reference — this file is. Both assert against it, so a change to one side that the other does not mirror fails loudly instead of surfacing later as an unexplained fidelity mismatch. Regenerating these values is a grammar change: bump VERSION on both sides and treat it as a format change (docs/architecture/format-versioning.md).

basic.why: a read, a write, a response — the common shape

mixed.why: every element kind, including a not-found read and a scan

overlong.why: a key past maxInlineKey must take the folded fallback on BOTH sides at the same byte

nonascii.why: folds UTF-8 BYTES, not chars — a char-length or latin1 path diverges here

byteThreshold.why: 200 two-byte chars = 400 BYTES but 200 chars: the overlong fallback must trigger on the BYTE length. A char-length threshold passes every other vector and fails only this one.
